After each completed turn it can also predict your like"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ly next prompt and show it as a one-click suggestion tip below the web composer (web GUI only). Neit"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"her surface pollutes or recursively reviews itself."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Advisory only.** The advisor never approves or rejects the primary agent's actions, and never issu"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"es commands as if it were the primary agent. Every delivered message is self-described advisory cont"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ent, and a misbehaving reviewer is bounded end to end (emission guard, immuneTurns cooldown, failure"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" policy) so it can never stall or pollute the primary loop."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Works in both dsh front ends: the **web** profile (sidebar → Plugins → dsh-advisor → Advisor card) a"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nd the **dsh-tui** terminal profile (`/advisor` + `/advisor config`)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"#### Web / Desktop (Plugins page)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"In the dsh web client or the desktop app, open the sidebar **Plugins** page, use **Add plugin**, ent"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"er the package name `dsh-advisor`, press **Install**, then **Enable now**."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"#### `dsh` CLI"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Configuration"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Edit the `config` of the `advisor` row in your profile's patch layer (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cor"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"dis.patch.yml`). All nine fields are schema-volatile live fields (dsh ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1): the web card an"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"d the TUI `/settings` screen write this same entry config — persisted in the profile patch, committe"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"d without a remount. (A pre-0.1.7 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` `advisor:` section no longer exists: dsh"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" imports it into the active profile once and renames the file `.imported`.)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Independent reviewer per session**: a separate model call observes the primary transcript and re"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"views each stepped primary turn; advisor messages are excluded from later deltas, so the advisor doe"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"s not read its own advice back. The exclusion recognizes the advisor's current producer kind (`advis"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"or`) AND both historical shapes a still-openable log can carry: the prehistoric direct `{ kind: 'adv"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"isor' }` note and the 0.1.6-era note as the V3→V4 in-memory migration rewrote it (`kind: 'plugin:adv"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"isor'`) — no generation of persisted notes is orphaned by the identity migration.
- **Severity-ranke"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"d advice with inject/steer semantics**: at most one note per review — **nit** (a minor style, clarit"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"y, or quality suggestion; delivered via non-waking `agent.inject`, consumed at the next pre-step bou"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"ndary), **concern** (a material risk or clearly better direction to weigh before continuing; deliver"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"ed via waking `agent.steer`, subject to the `immuneTurns` cooldown), **blocker** (continuing clearly"},{"id":"p18s11","text":" wastes work — contradicts an explicit user instruction, going in circles, fundamentally unsound; de"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"livered via `agent.steer`). Delivered messages carry the `[advisor:{severity}]` prefix and are self-"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"described advisory content:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Explicit model gate**: a missing `provider` + `model` never starts a model call — status reports"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" disabled-with-reason. The gate applies to the *effective* route after session resolution: a complet"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"e per-session override pair satisfies it for that session; a malformed global config cannot be bypas"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"sed. Unknown config keys are rejected — the removed `enabled` key is the one legacy exception (silen"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"tly ignored; the plugin-row toggle is the switch).
- **Zero-tool minimal start**: the reviewer is an"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" independent model call only — no advisor tools, nothing it can do to the session besides advisory m"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"essages.
- **No-stall failure policy**: a failing or quota-limited advisor only drops its own bounde"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"d backlog — it can never park or pollute the primary loop.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Limitations & roadmap"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The MVP deliberately drops full omp parity. Accepted gaps (tracked in the harness iteration roadmap)"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"he MVP deliberately drops full omp parity. Accepted gaps (tracked in the harness iteration roadmap):"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Single advisor per session** — no parallel advisor roster or WATCHDOG-style file discovery (next"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" iteration).
- **No advisor tools** — the reviewer is an independent model call only; it cannot veri"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"fy claims itself (next-next iteration).
- **No in-session advisor panel** — advice surfaces only as "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"tagged injected messages; the web Advisor card is a config surface, not a session view (next-next it"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"eration).
- **No transcript persistence or cost stats** — no resumable advisor history or cost obser"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"vability (next-next iteration).
- **No secret obfuscation of delta content** — secrets present in th"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"e transcript can reach the advisor model; mitigate by configuring a trusted reviewer model.
- **No q"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"uarantine of unsafe advisor output** — a misbehaving note can carry directive text; the JSON frame +"},{"id":"p23s9","text":" validation + advisory-only framing are the only mitigation, and the note is delivered as-is (roadma"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"p).
- **No `syncBacklog` catch-up wait** — a far-behind advisor does not wait for the primary loop; "},{"id":"p23s11","text":"its backlog is bounded and dropped, so notes may arrive after the next primary turn started (roadmap"},{"id":"p23s12","text":": context-maintenance batch).
- **Bounded advisor context** — long-session full replays are truncate"},{"id":"p23s13","text":"d (`maxDeltaMessages`), so the advisor may lose early context after compaction (roadmap: next-next i"},{"id":"p23s14","text":"taMessages`), so the advisor may lose early context after compaction (roadmap: next-next iteration)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Sessions written by earlier versions — pre-V3 logs are not repaired here.** Advisor notes in them "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"carry the former custom `source.kind` (`kind: 'advisor'`), which the dsh V2→V3 session-format edge r"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"efuses, so those **pre-V3** logs cannot be migrated (the raw file is intact, only unopenable). Logs "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"already at V3 still open — they are affected only by the self-review caveat above.
